root_cause.text: Multiple Ceph filesystem callers failed to zero-initialize local `ceph_path_info` stack variables before passing them to `ceph_mdsc_build_path()`, causing `ceph_mdsc_free_path_info()` to dereference garbage pointers upon function failure and corrupt the slab allocator.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `= {0}` initializers to `struct ceph_path_info` declarations in `debugfs.c`, `dir.c`, `file.c`, and `inode.c`; the CVE description explicitly states `ceph_mdsc_build_path()` initializes the structure only on success, but callers invoke `ceph_mdsc_free_path_info()` regardless of success/failure, necessitating zero-initialization to prevent crashes.
